title.en: Pro X (PRX) Silo Extensions Pro Edition

description.en:
Pro X 9000 (PRX9000) Category: Silo Extensions Price: $450,000 Monthly upkeep: $100
Pro X 8000 (PRX8000) Category: Silo Extensions Price: $360,000 Monthly upkeep: $80
Pro X 6000 (PRX6000) Category: Silo Extensions Price: $270,000 Monthly upkeep: $60
Pro X (PRX): huge corrugated steel silo extensions with a caged ladder. All 18 m wide.
PRX9000: 10,000,000 L, 32 m walls PRX8000: 8,000,000 L, 25.6 m walls PRX6000: 6,000,000 L, 19.2 m walls
Place one near one of your silos to add its storage.
Changelog 1.7.3.4: - Description in GIANTS' ModHub layout (category, price, upkeep or hotkeys at the top). - Shop images without mipmaps, as ModHub wants.
